messages: O Luiz Pasquale não faz parte do nosso curso de violão.
O professor responsável pelo curso 'Aulas de Violão do Zero ao Fingerstyle' é o Rafael Alves.
Você gostaria de saber mais sobre o curso do Rafael Alves?

Luiz Pasquale is an instructor who specializes in Classical Guitar and has an MBA in the subject. He has 10 years of experience and is known for being very friendly. You can find him on social media at @pasqualefilho.
He's not directly involved with our 'Zero to Fingerstyle Guitar Lessons' course, which is taught by Rafael Alves.
